steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ Responses tab containing Vendor A's and Vendor B's bids.
Ensure the RFQ counter-offer control is enabled for the tenant.
Ensure eRFX projects are enabled as required by the setup.
Send Vendor A a counter offer changing the quoted price from 100 to 90 with the required remark.
Assert that Vendor A's bid is marked as having a counter offer initiated.
Assert that the sent offer replaces the Counter Offer control with Revoke Counter Offer.
Open the event overview to inspect the participant summary after sending the counter offer.
Assert that the participant summary exposes the Active Counter Offers category.
Switch to Vendor A's supplier-portal session to verify receipt of the counter offer.
Open the prepared event's overview in the vendor portal.
Assert that Vendor A is presented with the action to accept the pending counter offer.
Assert that the vendor view identifies the pending counter offer.
